item.title: Memory Management in Linux
item.description:
Virtual Memory

Linux uses virtual memory to allow processes to use more memory than physically available.

Page Tables

The kernel maintains page tables to map virtual addresses to physical addresses.

item.title: File Systems Basics

File System Types

Common file systems include ext4, NTFS, and APFS.

Inodes

An inode stores metadata about a file including permissions, ownership, and timestamps.
